title: New Oak Park Library Under Construction!
description:
Exciting chapter ahead! 👏 The Oak Park Library is officially under construction.

Mayor Todd Gloria and Councilmember Henry L. Foster III joined City staff and community members to break ground for this state-of-the-art facility. It will replace the original 1969 branch and expand services for the San Diego Public Library system. 

#SanDiegoAtWork #OakPark #Library
